title: A Survey on End-to-End Autonomous Driving Training from the Perspectives of Data, Strategy, and Platform
abstract: arXiv:2610.00926v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous driving is a cornerstone technology for the future of intelligent transportation, where end-to-end learning has emerged as a transformative paradigm that directly maps multimodal sensory inputs to driving actions through unified differentiable models. While offering advantages, the effectiveness of end-to-end autonomous driving (E2E-AD) is ultimately determined by the quality of its training ecosystem. This paper provides a comprehensive review of training methods and ecosystem for E2E-AD. We introduce a Data-Strategy-Platform taxonomy that conceptualizes training as an interdependent system. The data layer defines what can be learned, the strategy layer governs how learning aligns with driving objectives, and the platform layer supports scalability and continuous evolution. translated_title: 从数据、策略与平台视角看端到端自动驾驶训练综述
translated_abstract: 自动驾驶是未来智能交通的基石技术，其中端到端学习已成为一种变革性范式，它通过统一的可微分模型将多模态感知输入直接映射为驾驶动作。尽管具有诸多优势，端到端自动驾驶（E2E-AD）的有效性最终取决于其训练生态系统的质量。本文对端到端自动驾驶的训练方法和生态系统进行了全面综述。我们提出了一种“数据-策略-平台”分类体系，将训练概念化为一个相互依赖的系统：数据层定义了可以学习什么，策略层规范学习如何与驾驶目标对齐，平台层支持可扩展性与持续演进。在该框架下，我们综述了以数据为中心的流程、学习范式以及训练基础设施方面的最新进展，并分析了它们的整合。
tldr: 本文提出“数据-策略-平台”三层分类框架，将端到端自动驾驶训练视为一个相互依赖的整体系统，系统综述了训练数据、学习策略与训练平台的最新进展及其协同关系。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Data-Strategy-Platform taxonomy that conceptualizes end-to-end autonomous driving training as an interdependent system, systematically surveying recent advances in training data, learning strategies, and training infrastructures.
